title: Customer voice pipeline -> solution threads (Sales/CS intake aggregation & rapid scoping)
creator: Asha Rao
description:
Problem statement: Sales and CS surface a high volume of non-bug enterprise feature requests with inconsistent context. PMs and Engs spend ~3–5 hours per request to synthesize business value, technical scope, and recommended outcomes. This creates delays in prioritization and a growing backlog of half-scoped asks. Goal: build a lightweight, repeatable 'Customer Voice Pipeline' that aggregates Sales/CS feature asks into coherent 'solution threads' and produces a rapid scoping artifact (1–2 slides + 2-level effort estimate) suitable for prioritization, early engineering review, and rsourcing decisions.

Scope of this ticket: design the intake template, scoring rubric, triage rules, and handoff outputs; pilot the flow with two Sales segments (AE-led enterprise and Strategic CS); produce templates and a short SOP for reps and CS to fill. Deliverables: intake form (spreadsheet + Linear template), scoring scorecard, scoping one-pager template, routing rules (triage -> PM backlog / roadmap candidate / research spike), and a pilot runbook.

Key intake fields to capture (must be present in template): customer name, contact, ACV or estimated deal size, product area impacted, use-case narrative, success metric, expected user count, regulatory/data residency needs, integration complexity (low/medium/high), urgency & timeline, requested deliverable (API/console/change), security/compliance flags, known blockers, account tier. The scoring rubric will weight ACV, strategic signal, technical risk, and time-to-value to produce a 0–100 priority score.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Sales/CS can complete intake in <15 minutes for a single ask; 2) PM can produce a 1-slide scoping summary in <60 minutes using the intake; 3) Scorecard aligns with prioritization decisions in two pilot accounts during the 2-week pilot; 4) Handback loop to Sales for clarifying questions is <= 48 hours.

Trade-offs and constraints: keep the intake lightweight to avoid blocking adoption vs. capturing enough context for meaningful scoping. Initial pilot will accept conservative technical estimates (T-shirt sizing) rather than full engineering stories. Some enterprise asks require Legal/CISO input — those will be flagged and routed separately (see routing rules).
acceptance_criteria: Intake template (sheet + Linear template) finalized and published to Sales drive
Scorecard defined and implemented as a column in the intake sheet; score computed automatically
Pilot: 8–12 asks processed across AE and Strategic CS segments with PM scoping outputs produced
SOP and playbook published with roles, SLAs, and escalation paths
At least one ask progressed to an engineering spike or roadmap candidate during the pilot
